optimizations.title: Optimize: Duplicate Search
task: The pre-loaded `find_duplicates` algorithm operates correctly but utilizes an inefficient brute-force methodology. The objective is to refactor the logic to achieve a linear O(n) time complexity.
1. Review the Complexity tab to identify the O(n²) global time bottleneck caused by the redundant nested iterations.
2. Remove the inner loop construct and its associated conditional evaluations entirely.
3. Initialize an empty tracking list prior to the primary loop to record evaluated elements.
4. Within the single iterative loop, verify if the current element exists in the tracking list. If found, return the element to terminate execution.
5. If not found, append the element to the tracking list.
6. Retain the terminal `return -1` statement and confirm the refactored O(n) bound in the analytical feedback.
